update t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a a.instance_id_one = #{instanceIdOne}, a.instance_id_two = #{instanceIdTwo}, a.one_cruise_device_name = #{oneCruiseDeviceName}, a.two_cruise_device_name = #{twoCruiseDeviceName}, a.cruise_name = #{cruiseName}, a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId}, a.device_id = #{deviceId}, a.custom_id = #{customId}, a.identify_type = #{identifyType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.identify_son_type = #{identifySonType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.cruise_type = #{cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.warn_threshold = #{warnThreshold, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.warn_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.interval_type = #{intervalType, jdbcType=INTEGER},
where a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.instance_id, a.station_id, a.station_name, a.instance_id_one, a.instance_id_two, b.cruise_name as oneCruiseDeviceName, c.cruise_name as twoCruiseDeviceName, d.device_mete_name, d.custom_id, f.device_id, d.mete_name, d.custom_name, f.device_name, a.identify_type, a.identify_son_type, a.cruise_type, a.warn_threshold, a.warn_level, a.interval_type, a.if_sy, a.sy_type from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = a.instance_id_one left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = a.instance_id_two left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id left join t_std_device f on f.device_id = a.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

c.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on a.device_id = e.device_id left join t_dict_business b on c.custom_id = b.dict_code and b.col_name = 'custom_type' where 1 = 1 and a.instance_id = select count(m.instance_id) from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance m where m.instance_id_one in (#{instanceIdOne},#{instanceIdTwo}) or m.instance_id_two in (#{instanceIdOne},#{instanceIdTwo})

select IFNULL(h.robot_name,j.camera_name) as name from t_cruise_point_instance a left join t_robot_inspection g on g.inspection_id = a.cruise_id left join t_robot_info h on h.robot_id = g.robot_id left join t_camera_preset i on i.preset_id = a.cruise_id left join t_camera_info j on j.camera_id = i.camera_id where a.instance_id = #{instanceId}

select a.warn_id as warnId, a.instance_id as instanceId, a.warn_content as warnContent, a.warn_time as warnTime, a.device_mete_name as deviceMeteTime, d.custom_id as customId, e.device_id as deviceId, d.device_mete_id as deviceMeteId, a.custom_name as customName, a.device_name as deviceName, e.device_type as deviceType, a.device_type_name as deviceTypeName, a.region_name as delayName, f.region_id as delayId, a.warn_type as warnType, a.warn_level as warnLevel, a.one_cruise_device_name as oneCruiseDeviceName, a.two_cruise_device_name as twoCruiseDeviceName from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn a left join t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance n on n.instance_id = a.instance_id left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = n.one_cruise_device_name left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = n.two_cruise_device_name left join t_std_devicemete d on d.device_mete_id = n.device_mete_id left join t_std_device e on d.device_id = e.device_id left join t_std_region f on e.up_region_id = f.region_id where 1 = 1 and a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select a.warn_id as warnId, a.task_id as taskId, a.inspection_id as instanceId from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection a where a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT d.device_name, dm.mete_name, t.task_id, t.inspection_id, db.dict_note AS device_type_name, dm.custom_name, f.region_name
FROM ( SELECT inspection_id, task_id FROM t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection WHERE warn_id = #{warnId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) t LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_point_instance` tcpi ON t.inspection_id = tcpi.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON tcpi.device_id = d.device_id left join t_std_region f on d.up_region_id = f.region_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete dm ON tcpi.device_mete_id = dm.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business db ON d.device_type = db.dict_code

select robot_name as robotName FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_id IN ( SELECT robot_id FROM u_patrol_plan_attr WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT plan_id FROM u_patrol_task WHERE task_code = #{taskId}) AND instance_id = #{inspectionId}) limit 1

SELECT a.warn_id, a.instance_id, a.warn_type, a.warn_content, a.warn_time, a.one_cruise_device_name, a.two_cruise_device_name, a.three_cruise_device_name, a.device_name, a.device_type_name, a.device_mete_name, a.region_name, a.custom_name FROM t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn a WHERE warn_id = #{warnId}
